role: Awwwards-level web designer and front-end craftsperson
verdict: The page holds its composition at 1440, 390 and 360 with measured CLS of 0.00002, no horizontal scroll, no console errors, every heading at two lines, about 176 KB transferred, and a finished static layout under reduced motion with no looping animation. I found no P0 or P1; what is left is small spacing and alignment polish that is not visible in the first seconds of any section.

measured.headings: h1 and every h2 are exactly 2 lines at 1440, 390 and 360
measured.transfer: Inter 71 KB, avatars 90 KB, you-dark 15 KB; photos lazy
measured.reduced_motion: 0 running animations, no hidden text; normal mode has 0 infinite animations
measured.sheet: opens with focus on Continue with X, invalid email gives a plain error, Esc closes and returns focus to the opener

issues.where: #sharpen at 1440, result row: the white pill (Sharpen every post free / Schedule it free / Keep it. Start free) under #out-card
issues.problem: The pill sits about 10px under the post card while the Why it hits column beside it ends higher, so the CTA reads as stuck to the card and the bottom-left of the panel looks tighter than the 24-28px rhythm used everywhere else in the cell.
issues.fix: Give the pill 18-20px top margin (match the gap between the starters row and the result status line), and bottom-align it with the last line of the Why column at >=1024.

issues.where: #pricing at 1440, 'Pay for volume, never for the basics.'
issues.problem: The sub-line is pushed to the far right edge on the baseline of 'Forever.', roughly 630px from the headline it belongs to, so at first glance it reads as a stray caption rather than the heading's second thought; the FAQ header puts its sub-line directly under the heading, so the two section headers are inconsistent.
issues.fix: Place it under the h2 like the FAQ sub-line (left-aligned, 16px below), or keep it right but bottom-align it with the Yearly/Monthly toggle row so it shares a line with a real element.

issues.where: First bento row at 1440: 'Your facts stay.' (40px, top 216) beside 'One draft. Four feeds.' (30px, top 210)
issues.problem: The two neighbouring cells start their headings about 6px apart and their first baselines do not align, which is visible when the row first scrolls in.
issues.fix: Align first baselines across the row: add ~6px top padding to the Previews cell heading (or set both cells' heading blocks to the same cap-height offset).

issues.where: #day at 1440: the '8:40 AM' chip on the divider and the phone
issues.problem: The '8:40 AM' chip sits on the seam between the night photo and the phone column, attached to neither side, while 'Replay' is pinned top-right with a different inset; and the phone's top shows an empty 40px band under the avatar before the tabs when the notification is not showing.
issues.fix: Anchor the time chip inside the phone column with the same 20px inset as Replay (left of the phone, same top), and collapse the empty band under the avatar when the notification is hidden.

issues.where: Try box, line '5 things i learned losing 40% of my account: 1) size 2) stops and also honestly a really long line...'
issues.problem: The kept note reads 'Kept 5 things, 40%, 2 and your lowercase.': it counts the list marker '2' as a kept fact (and not '1'), which looks like a glitch. Struck words are also only about 18x20px tap targets at 390 for the 'Tap a struck word to put it back' action.
issues.fix: Do not list bare list markers such as '1)' or '2)' in the Kept line; add 6px vertical padding (with negative margin) to struck words on touch widths so the tap area reaches 28px+ without changing line height.
